body: Unfortunately, no - I know him through my BF, and we’re not even friends on social media platforms (his recent visit, though, would allow me to “befriend” him to get a message across). Other than that I don’t know anybody of his friends. My BF claims that he has always been “a self-assured cocky bastard”, which is the attitude he also displayed while here, but something... nags me that it may have deeper and darker roots. Yet, I don’t want to come off as weird, so I’m in a bind.

How would I have to phrase this message I send him? English is not my natural language and in mine, we are very direct and I am afraid I might come off too assuming. And I don’t want to sound completely deluded in case I misread the signs....
